presets.name: Voice clarity
presets.note: Less boom and mud, a little more presence and air: a common first move on a spoken voice.

presets.name: Rumble cut
presets.note: A deep low shelf below 80 Hz takes out traffic, handling noise and air conditioning.

presets.name: De-mud
presets.note: A broad 4 dB dip around 300 Hz clears a boxy or muddy sound.

presets.name: Presence lift
presets.note: 3 dB around 4 kHz helps a voice cut through music or effects.

presets.name: Air lift
presets.note: A gentle high shelf from 12 kHz for openness and sparkle.

presets.name: Telephone
presets.note: Cuts the lows and highs and lifts 1.5 kHz, like a voice on a phone line.
